comment: Her lectures are just her reading off of slides. You don't learn anything, her rubrics stink, and you can never do anything right. She also loves the topic too much and expects way too much out of u.

You will probably get a good grade but alot of tiny points will be taken off on any assignment. Very slow grader but helpful out of class and can be greatly accomadating. Nice and tries to make class as interesting as possible. Not much hw outside of lab work.

Very compassionate and understanding! Was very enthusiastic and passionate about the topics but made them enjoyable for students as well. Was always super easy to meet with outside the classroom and truly wanted all her students to succeed. VERY minimal homework as well :) Would definitely take again and recommend to others

Dr. Grayson is an amazing professor. She cares about all of her students and clearly wants them all to succeed, so long as you put in the effort to challenge yourself. Dr. Grayson is always available to meet with students and always expresses her passion for the subject. Would 100% recommend.

I loved Dr. Grayson! Definitely a good professor who cares about her students. She's really nice about late work, and doesn't give very much homework. We did a lot of fun labs despite covid restrictions. She handled everything really well.

Dr. Grayson is an actual god send. I've taken her twice now, and she is an incredible, passionate, and caring professor. She is clear about her expectations and wants you to do well, but she tries at all costs to avoid being a stressor in your life. She cares about all of her students and is always available to them if they need ANYTHING.
Dr. Grayson is nice and makes the topic interesting, but can be a bit unclear on her expectations especially for lab assignments. harsh considering the topic was broad compared to bio 200.
Took forever to hand back graded assignments. Not a huge fan of ecology but Dr. Grayson did a good job teaching the material. Biology classes in general are easy and this one was no different.

She is super helpful and wants you to succeed Not many people like Ecology, but she makes it enjoyable. You learn a lot from her, but there's a trade-off: Her tests are hard, but if you do the pre-lecture readings, pay attention in class and follow her slides, you'll be fine.

Great professor. Very reasonable grader. You'll learn in the class and she wants to be sure you succeed. Reading the text is very important for the exams but she explains it fairly well during lectures. She's one of the newer professors but nonetheless one of best professors in the biology department so you definitely want to take her class!

Class with Grayson feels like a breeze. She lectures every class, but makes it interesting with video breaks. I took notes on my computer every class, and used only those when preparing for exams. She's a very fair tester and grader. She's enthusiastic during labs, and willing to help. I'd retake Bio 199 just to have her again - SUCH a sweet woman!
